text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and D simply because they were above my average cost; whether a position is profitable is not, by itself, a reason to sell.","Selling winners while continuing to hold or add to weaker positions can distort my portfolio; I should assess each holding by its role and my overall allocation, not by avoiding the regret of realizing a loss.","My short record shows no dependable price pattern. I should not treat recent moves as forecasts, and should follow a consistent, diversified plan rather than react to them."]}
